help.mcp.title: MCP & external IDEs
help.mcp.hint: Drive the same Maya tools and Agent from Cursor / VS Code / Claude Desktop.
help.mcp.1: Start it from Maya Agent → Start MCP or Settings → MCP Bridge; it listens on 127.0.0.1 only, with a token regenerated on every start
help.mcp.2: Install MCP deps with your system Python: pip install -r requirements-mcp.txt (not mayapy)
help.mcp.3: Use Copy MCP Config and paste it into the IDE's mcp.json; discovery data lives in %APPDATA%/MayaAgent/bridge.json (host / port / token)
help.mcp.4: 4 meta tools: mayaagent_status (status), mayaagent_chat (full Agent loop), mayaagent_undo (undo last turn), mayaagent_system_prompt (refresh prompt)
help.mcp.5: All other Maya tools are callable directly; they share the panel's registry, system prompt, and undo semantics; destructive tools follow the confirm mode
help.mcp.6: The panel and IDE share one Agent, so only one chat runs at a time; the token is a local credential — do not leak it; after editing the prompt md, reconnect MCP or call mayaagent_system_prompt
help.chat.10: Each reply footer shows the model, request count, and token usage; tool cards expand to show arguments, results, and returned images
help.chat.11: Ask for charts on numeric comparisons or distributions — generate_chart (line / bar / box / scatter / hist / pie) embeds them into the reply

help.rules.title: Guidelines & safety
help.rules.hint: The Agent follows these constraints — use it with that in mind.
help.rules.1: Work stays in the open scene by default; it will not create a new empty scene or save unless you ask
help.rules.2: When intent is unclear or options differ, it asks with clickable choices first
help.rules.3: Destructive actions (delete, overwrite export, run arbitrary scripts, …) ask first (disable under Model → LLM → Behavior)
help.rules.4: Prefer registered tools; use execute_python / execute_mel only for complex logic (atomic rollback by default)
help.rules.5: Keep Auto undo chunk on so one turn undoes with Ctrl+Z; MCP can call mayaagent_undo
help.rules.6: Put temps in the temp directory; local file I/O is allowlisted (workspace / temp / Maya user dirs)
help.rules.7: Cloud AI 3D uses provider quota — the Agent checks balance / cost and asks before submitting jobs
help.rules.8: Use the composer mode switch: Agent (full tools), Ask (read-only), Plan (propose a plan card, then approve before scene edits)
help.rules.9: Long chats compress older tool results for the LLM (sidecar keeps full text); duplicate read-only calls are deduped and consecutive identical calls are fused
help.rules.10: Add project conventions under Settings → User Rules (or project rules/*.md); rules inject into the system prompt and cannot bypass Ask / destructive confirms
rules.section_hint: Persistent project conventions injected into every system prompt. You can also drop .md/.txt into project rules/ (_-prefixed files are drafts and skipped).
rules.enabled_tip: When off, no user rules are sent to the model
rules.file_readonly: Edit file rules in the rules/ folder; read-only here.
rules.empty_hint: No rules yet. Create a UI rule, or add .md/.txt under project rules/.
status.tool_dedup: Deduplicated: reused prior result this turn
status.tool_loop_guard: Fused: too many consecutive identical tool calls
help.more.title: Menu & reload
help.more.hint: After install, open from the Maya menu or shelf.
help.more.1: Maya Agent menu: Open Panel / Reload / Start MCP / Stop MCP / Copy MCP Config / About
help.more.2: MayaAgent shelf tab: Agent button; docked mode tabs next to the Attribute Editor by default
help.more.3: After code changes use Reload; if the panel looks stale, close it (or restart Maya) and open again
help.more.4: If tool_count looks wrong, drag recover_tools_dragdrop.mel into the viewport, or run maya_agent.reload() then restart MCP
help.more.5: Dependency / install-path changes: re-run install.bat and restart Maya; read-only check: python scripts/doctor.py
help.more.6: API keys can also come from env vars (DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, XAI_API_KEY, DASHSCOPE_API_KEY, MESHY_API_KEY, TRIPO_API_KEY, TENCENTCLOUD_SECRET_ID/KEY, …)
help.more.7: Switch UI language under Settings — the panel rebuilds; the system prompt is Chinese, with an output-language footer for other locales
help.tools.note_destructive: ⚠ Destructive tools (delete, unwrap, open scene, write files, run scripts, …) prompt when Confirm destructive ops is on.
help.tools.note_vision: Vision tools (capture_viewport* / render_still / fetch_image*) only appear for vision-capable models; cloud tools hide when keys are missing/invalid, and matching prompt sections hide too.
help.tools.note_threads: Network / file / cloud tools run off the Maya main thread; scene tools run on the main thread.
